source.title: Call for Applicants - WST Leader (October 2020)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Software Team (WST) Leader**, as Philippe Virouleau is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Philippe for the work he has done leading the Team.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 10 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong technical expertise
* Good communication
* Problem solving skills
* Goal-oriented
* Project management experience

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **November 3rd, 2020, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WST Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WST can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2017.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.4%20-%20Software%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 软件组负责人（2020 年 10 月）
translation.content:
Philippe Virouleau 即将卸任 **WCA 软件组（WST）负责人**，我们将任命新负责人。感谢 Philippe 在带领团队期间所做的工作。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 10 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

* 扎实的技术能力。
* 善于沟通。
* 解决问题的能力。
* 做事目标明确。
* 有项目管理经验。

申请截止时间为 **2020 年 11 月 3 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
* 担任 WCA 软件组负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WST 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2017.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.4%20-%20Software%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
